title: Withheld placeholder must not encode original output size
reason_not_testable: Two gaps in the fixture format: (1) no way to force the hook to fail or withhold, and (2) no assertion that two model-visible strings are byte-identical across fixtures. The seq 1 12000 stdout (about 58 KB) would also have to be a literal in the fixture file. Non-hook control: none defined in the spec (UNVERIFIED); needs a runner feature for forced-withhold and cross-fixture equality.
